usage:
Usage: halo [--backend auto|lamparray|vendor|dummy] COMMAND

  set COLOR | C1 C2 C3 C4       one color, or one per zone (left bottom, left top, right top, right bottom)
  pick                          choose the color with the KDE color dialog (kdialog)
  brightness 0-3                hardware brightness (0 turns the rings off whatever paints them)
  restore                       send the last saved color and brightness again
  release                       hand the rings back to the firmware
  status                        what Halo found and how everything is
  eq                            toggle the music equalizer; needs the daemon
  effect [EFFECT] [SPEED]       start an effect at slow|medium|fast (`halo effect` lists them and
                                shows the current one); `effect off` stops it
  effect colors EFFECT C..|auto custom colors of an effect (breathing 1-2, tide 2, starry sky
                                then stars, comet 1, pulse any number); `auto` restores the defaults
  effect direction EFFECT normal|reverse
                                run rainbow, cycle, comet and tide backwards
  config [KEY VALUE]            show or change halo.conf: latitude, longitude (degrees or auto),
                                screen_off yes|no, hardware_effects yes|no; applied at once with the daemon
  games [on|off]                whether games may control the lights (Chroma, GameSense); with
                                nothing, lists the connected and blocked games
  games block|allow GAME        block or allow one game by name (as shown by `halo games`)
  profile [APPID VALUE|remove]  per-game profile: when the Steam game opens, VALUE is shown (a color,
                                one per zone, an effect or off) and the usual lights come back when
                                it closes; with nothing, lists the profiles and the running game
  proton [list]                 Steam games with a Proton prefix and whether they have the bridge
  proton install APPID|--all    put Halo's Chroma/GameSense/Logitech bridge in the game's prefix
  proton remove APPID|--all     remove it (only Halo's files; never Razer's)
  proton scan [APPID]           look for lighting SDKs inside the installed games
  daemon                        run the daemon (halo.service starts it)
  layer NAME PRIO C1..C4        a layer above the base color ("" = transparent); needs the daemon
  unlayer NAME                  remove a layer

COLOR = RRGGBB | #RRGGBB | red orange yellow green cyan blue purple magenta pink white off
With an explicit --backend, commands go straight to the hardware even if the daemon is running.
